basics.name: Luis López Fernández
basics.summary: AI Engineer & Project Lead specializing in translating complex data into production-ready solutions. Over 10+ years bridging research and industry to ship computer vision, spatial intelligence, and generative AI systems at scale.
highlights: Led AI and innovation projects that turn complex data into value-added solutions.
Designed and delivered real-time perception and ADAS solutions in the automotive domain.
Built geospatial and spatial intelligence pipelines combining LiDAR, imagery and GNSS data.
Developed and integrated generative AI prototypes into Hexagon’s products and processes.
Acted as an interface between researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to identify and deliver measurable impact.
Contributed to the AI and geospatial communities through publications, talks and mentoring.

work.name: Hexagon Innovation Hub GmbH
highlights: Architected AI solutions for efficient processing of multimodal data (point clouds, imagery, GNSS).
Managed and executed research projects, proofs of concept, and feasibility studies.
Designed ML infrastructure for scalable training and deployment of models in production.
Coordinated multidisciplinary teams of engineers & researchers across departments.
Designed and implemented generative AI solutions supporting Hexagon AB processes and product portfolio.
Spearheaded LLM and multimodal generation initiatives for enterprise integration.

work.name: Tidop Research Group — University of Salamanca
highlights: Led research on geomatics & machine learning applications for energy optimisation.
Contributed to software development & scientific publications on remote sensing.
Conducted research and consulting in photogrammetry, computer vision, and artificial intelligence.
Collaborated on funded research projects and academic–industry partnerships.
Provided technical guidance on data fusion & 3D modelling methods.

work.name: CTAG — Automotive Technology Centre of Galicia
highlights: Developed real-time LiDAR processing stack for ADAS platforms of automotive OEMs.
Created calibration & perception algorithms for RADAR, LiDAR & camera systems.
Facilitated Agile/Scrum processes improving team velocity & delivery quality.

work.name: INSITU Engineering
highlights: Managed AI and computer vision R&D projects combining GNSS, LiDAR and imagery data.
Designed multi-sensor calibration strategies for infrastructure inspection systems.
Coordinated technical development teams & project stakeholders.

education.studyType: PhD: Geotechnologies applied to Construction, Energy and Industry
highlights: Advanced research in computer vision & photogrammetry (feature extraction, multimodal registration, 3D reconstruction) applied to energy-efficiency assessment in built environments.
Developed automated workflows integrating thermal imaging, LiDAR, and RGB data for detection, quantification, and geospatial modelling of energy-loss patterns in industrial and civil infrastructure.
Published and disseminated findings through peer-reviewed papers, conference presentations, and collaborative projects bridging academic research with industry energy-optimisation use cases.

education.studyType: MSc: Cartographic Geotechnologies applied to Engineering and Architecture
highlights: Integrated software engineering best practices (modular geospatial data pipelines, version-controlled photogrammetry & LiDAR processing) for reproducible cartographic workflows.
Applied ML & AI (feature extraction, multimodal registration, semantic segmentation) to geomatic datasets (UAV imagery, terrestrial/mobile LiDAR) enabling high-accuracy 3D reconstruction & mapping.
Engineered automated geospatial processing services (ETL for GNSS, imagery, point clouds; QA; metadata enrichment) to accelerate engineering & architectural decision support.
Built strong foundations in classical surveying: geodesy, topographic measurement, traverse & leveling adjustment, coordinate systems, and error propagation.

Executed field campaigns integrating traditional instruments (GNSS, total station) with modern reality-capture technologies (mobile/terrestrial LiDAR, UAV photogrammetry, panoramic imaging) for high-accuracy 3D mapping.
Applied multi-sensor spatial data fusion (LiDAR + imagery + GNSS) and remote sensing preprocessing (orthorectification, radiometric handling) to engineering decision support in capstone project.

education.studyType: VET: Advanced Vocational Training in Multiplatform & Web Application Development
highlights: Developed cross-platform desktop/mobile applications (Java, Kotlin, C#, Android) and full-stack web applications (HTML5/JS, Python/Node.js).
Implemented secure RESTful APIs, data persistence (SQL/ORM), and applied MVC/MVVM patterns with automated testing.
Collaborated using Agile/Scrum workflows and Git for version control and iterative delivery.

publications.name: Photomatch — Open-source multi-view and multi-modal feature matching tool for photogrammetric applications.
GRAPHOS — Open-source software for photogrammetric applications.
Feature matching evaluation for multimodal correspondence.
Automatic evaluation of photovoltaic power stations from high-density RGB-T 3D point clouds.
Large-scale automatic analysis and classification of roof surfaces for solar panel installation using multi-sensor aerial platforms.
Thermographic and mobile indoor mapping for energy-loss computation in buildings.
